title: Ibn Sahl's law of refraction
summary: In an optical treatise written around 984, Ibn Sahl set out the law describing how light bends between materials.
why: The basic law behind lenses, eyeglasses and cameras.

notes.problem: Source: Rashed reconstructed the text 'from two manuscripts (edited 1993)'; 'around 1990' is loose.

unsung.contribution: Has been described as the discoverer of the law of refraction, in a treatise of about 984.
unsung.recognition: The law is usually called Snell's law; his treatise was reconstructed from two manuscripts by Roshdi Rashed (1990, edited 1993).
